recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-3541 unless the work group wants to revisit the separate naming choice in a new issue.
issue_request: FHIR-3541 is a Published FHIR-core-ImagingStudy change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. Although the Jira title says the old dateTime element should be renamed to performed, the issue description and final resolution require renaming ImagingStudy.dateTime to ImagingStudy.started and updating the short/definition to describe when the study started.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in commit e621d20623aabcc8c4ceddf6fc115cc185c914c0, which explicitly references #3541 and changes the ImagingStudy example and then-authoritative imagingstudy spreadsheet from dateTime to started with started-oriented short and definition text. Later source refactors moved the resource definition into source/imagingstudy/structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition defines ImagingStudy.started with the expected short and definition, and current examples, search parameters, and invariant tests use started. No authoritative current ImagingStudy source still defines ImagingStudy.dateTime or an XML <dateTime> element for ImagingStudy; remaining dateTime hits in the resource are datatype declarations. No relevant Zulip or Confluence discussion was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already implements the final Jira resolution, and changing the element to performed would contradict the resolution text and current model.
